This is a finite positive case, not a solution of the original all-even question.

value.rationale: Ruskey's explicit 1989 even-size Gray-code question was still cataloged as open in a detailed 2023 survey. The length-ten case is a natural and substantial finite cutoff (50,521 configurations, 50,520 legal moves) that provides a complete positive existence certificate, together with smaller even cases, without suggesting a full solution or a general algorithm. The precise finite fact is not implied by Euler-number enumeration or existing odd-size Gray codes; the standalone certificate can be reused to test hypothetical general constructions.
